About Us

We're in the early (idea) stage of development and are looking for a hands on AI/ML expert to join as a founding engineer in this journey.

Role Overview

ASR & Speech Processing
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy ASR models (Whisper, wav2vec2, NeMo, or equivalent) for telephony audio across multiple languages and accents.
Build preprocessing pipelines: voice activity detection (VAD), noise suppression, audio normalization, handling for low-fidelity channels (compressed IVR, mobile).
Instrument ASR evaluation: measure WER on domain-specific test sets, identify failure modes (accent drift, domain vocabulary gaps), and propose targeted fine-tuning strategies.

Speaker Diarization & Attribution
Build end-to-end diarization systems that identify speaker boundaries, extract speaker embeddings, and cluster utterances to speakers.
Handle challenging scenarios: overlapping speech, short speaker turns, similar voices, noisy backgrounds.
Integrate diarization with ASR output, ensure each transcribed segment is correctly attributed to the speaker.

Post-Transcription NLP & Conversation Analysis
Design and evaluate intent classification models: purchase intent, complaints, escalations, policy violations, compliance triggers.
Implement sentiment and emotion extraction, tracking per-speaker turn and identifying call trajectory (positive -> negative or vice versa).
Build compliance detection pipelines: automatic PII/PHI redaction (using model-based approaches, not regex), regulatory language flagging (e.g., HIPAA, FCA regulations), and audit trail generation.
Architect LLM orchestration: decide when to fine-tune vs. prompt-engineer, which model (GPT-4, Claude, open-source) for each task, and implement guardrails against hallucinations.
Evaluate LLM outputs rigorously: factuality scoring, hallucination detection (using LLM-as-a-judge or perturbation methods), consistency checks.

Required Technical Skills

Speech Technologies (Deep Expertise)
ASR Models & Frameworks: Production experience with Whisper, wav2vec2, NVIDIA NeMo, or Conformer-based systems.
Diarization: Implemented speaker diarization pipelines (NeMo, pyannote.audio, or custom); understands embedding extraction, clustering algorithms (spectral clustering, DBSCAN), and failure modes.
Forced Alignment: Familiar with word-level timestamp generation (WhisperX, Kaldi, or custom wav2vec2 approaches).
Evaluation Metrics: Can articulate and measure WER, DER, WDER, speaker count error, latency (p50/p90/p99), and MOS. Can design custom metrics for domain-specific tasks.

NLP & Language Models
Fine-tuning vs. Prompt Engineering: Can decide which approach for a given task. Experience fine-tuning BERT, RoBERTa, or GPT models for text classification, NER, or intent detection.
Intent Classification & Sentiment Analysis: Built production intent classifiers (not just toy examples). Understands handling of overlapping intents, multi-label classification, and low-resource scenarios.
Prompt Engineering & RAG: Can design effective prompts, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and iterate on output quality without retraining.
RLHF & Guardrails: Familiar with reinforcement learning from human feedback; can implement output filters, constraint-based decoding, or custom scoring functions to prevent hallucinations.
Multi-LLM Orchestration: Experience evaluating and routing between models based on task, cost, latency, and quality. Can implement fallback strategies and cost optimization.

Production Systems & MLOps
Model Deployment: Shipped models to production using Docker, Kubernetes, KServe, or similar. Can reason about inference latency, throughput, and cost.
Data Pipelines: Built ETL/ELT pipelines for training and inference. Experience with distributed processing (Spark, Airflow, or Beam) for batch ASR.

Programming & Tools
Languages: Expert-level Python; comfortable with Go, JavaScript, or C++ for performance-critical components.
ML Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow; experience with HuggingFace Transformers library.
Audio Processing: librosa, scipy, or equivalent. Understand spectral analysis, MFCC, log-mel spectrograms, and waveform manipulation.
Distributed Computing: Experience with distributed training (PyTorch DDP, TensorFlow distributed) and batch processing.
Cloud Platforms: Comfortable with AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker, Lambda) or GCP/Azure equivalents.

Domain Knowledge (Conversation Intelligence)
Real-world call audio: Worked with actual phone recordings; understands IVR, codec compression (G.711, Opus), background noise, accent variation.
Telephony constraints: Understands PSTN latency, streaming vs. batch processing, and sub-second processing requirements.
Multilingual systems: Built ASR or NLP systems for non-English languages or code-switched speech (e.g., Hindi-English, Tamil-English).
Compliance: Familiar with HIPAA, PCI DSS, or GDPR requirements; understands sensitive data handling, audit trails, and redaction strategies.

Nice-to-Have Skills
Multilingual ASR: Trained or fine-tuned models for Indic languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi), Mandarin, or other languages.
Domain-Specific Language Models: Built custom language models for specialized vocabulary (medical, legal, financial).
Acoustic Adaptation: Implemented speaker or environment adaptation techniques to improve model robustness.
Reinforcement Learning: Trained models using RLHF or other RL techniques; experience with preference learning.
MLOps Infrastructure: Built end-to-end ML platforms: feature stores (Feast, Tecton), model registries, automated retraining pipelines.
Cloud Cost Optimization: Optimized ML workloads for cost (spot instances, batch scheduling, inference optimization).
Distributed Systems: Designed and debugged distributed training or inference systems; familiar with failure modes and debugging strategies.
Research Publication: Published research in speech, NLP, or conversational AI (venues like Interspeech, ACL, NeurIPS); maintains active engagement with the research community.
Open-Source Contribution: Contributed meaningfully to speech/NLP open-source projects (NeMo, Hugging Face, pyannote.audio).
Regulatory Knowledge: Familiar with HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, FCA, or India TRAI requirements; can design compliant systems.

At least 1-2 years working with speech recognition, NLP, or multimodal systems (not just generic ML).
Shipped production ML systems (not research code, not Kaggle competitions). You have debugged performance issues in the wild.
